text: Cancers involving the EGJ that have their epicenter within the proximal 2 cm of the cardia (Siewert types I/II) are to be staged as esophageal cancers (see the Esophagus (excluding GIST) chapter). Cancers whose epicenter is more than 2 cm distal from the EGJ, even if the EGJ is involved, will be staged using the stomach cancer chapter.
The Schema Discriminator EsophagusGEJunction (EGJ)/Stomach is used to discriminate between EsophagusGEJunction and Stomach which are coded to ICD-O-3 code C160
Non-invasive carcinomas in the esophagus formerly called in situ are now called high grade dysplasia.
High grade dysplasia and severe dysplasia are generally not reportable in cancer registries.
Code 0 if your registry collects these tumors
